column5: Ports executor-owned ExplainExec Open/Close/Next lifecycle, lazy external planner rendering, analyze-child drain and Next+Close error composition, panic normalization, retained no-delay child borrowing, actionable foreign-key-trigger borrowing, and the pure memory-debug interval policy. SQL dispatch remains intentionally unsupported until the real PlanBuilder, optimizer, physical-plan flattening, and planner-to-executor bridge land; runtime-statistics/RU registration and memory-debug goroutine/tracker/pprof logging also remain open.
